sentences.text:
In
 Criminal Application (St) No. 242 Of 2019
 Suman Ramu Madanwale ....Applic
 vs.
 The State of Maharashtra ... Respo
 None for the Applicant.
 Mr. D. J. Haldankar, App for the State.

Coram : Gauri Godse, J.
 Dated : 24th February 2026
This application is filed for condonation of delay in filing application under Section 378(4) of the Criminal Procedure Code(Cr.PC).

The applicant seeks leave to file appeal to challenge the order passed by the learned Sessions Court acquitting respondent nos. 2 and 3 for the offence punishable under Section 306 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
2. The acquittal order is not passed on any complaint.
Hence an application under Section 378(4) is not maintainable.
The applicant is the original complainant and mother of the RAJESHWARI RAMESH RAMESH PILLAI 2026.02.25 13:35:38 +0530 10-APPP-813-2019.doc deceased.
Hence, the applicant being a victim would be entitled to file appeal in view of the proviso to Section 372 of Cr.PC.
3. Office is therefore directed to convert the criminal application for leave to file appeal as an appeal under Section 372 of Cr.PC and accordingly convert the application for condonation of delay.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant shall carry out necessary amendment.
5. Office shall list the converted appeal before the court having assignment.

6. If the Advocate on record fails to carry out amendment and take appropriate steps within four weeks from today, office shall appoint Advocate from the High Court Legal Aid Committee to appear Suman Ramu Madanwale vs The State Of Maharashtra And Ors.
